team.name: Arif Hasan
bio: Started DotGrey in 2019 after seven years split between a network agency and an in-house product team, which is where the studio's dislike of account layers comes from.
Leads creative direction and still runs the first workshop on every engagement.

team.name: Nusrat Jahan
bio: Runs research and interface design across product engagements, and the usability sessions that keep the studio honest about its own assumptions.
Led the accessibility work on Medicove, which is now the reference the whole team designs against.

team.name: Tanvir Ahmed
bio: Owns architecture across every build — Next.js, TypeScript, headless CMS, and the CI that stops a heavy hero image reaching production.
Set the studio's performance budgets and enforces them in review, which has made a few designers grumpy and every client faster.

team.name: Mahdi Rahman
bio: Builds the email and Veeva work, and knows exactly which Outlook version will break which layout before anyone has to find out the hard way.
Maintains the studio's module library, which is why a campaign now takes an hour instead of a day.

team.name: Sadia Islam
bio: Handles everything that moves — launch films, product demos, and the interface motion specs that hand over to engineering as numbers rather than a reference video.
Storyboards on paper before opening anything, which saves a surprising amount of time.

team.name: Rifat Khan
bio: Keeps engagements on schedule and clients well informed, without becoming a layer between them and the people doing the work.
Writes the weekly follow-ups everyone actually reads, and flags schedule risk in writing before it becomes a problem.
